## Profile

Afnan Javed is a founder who works on business problems, product ideas and practical technology solutions. He has been building projects since 4th grade. His work combines business understanding, product planning and technology, with an emphasis on making useful ideas work in real situations.

His responsibilities and interests include product direction, understanding business needs, planning workflows, testing software, and improving products and projects over time. He works on products of his own as well as projects created around the needs of businesses and organizations.

## Work

### Dinaaro
Official website: https://dinaaro.com/
Type: Retail management software.

Dinaaro helps retailers manage sales, inventory, customer accounts, supplier records, expenses, staff shifts and business reporting in one connected system. It began as a tool for Afnan's own shop, where he wanted a better way to manage sales, stock, customer balances and business finances.

The product developed through use in daily operations and attention to the details that affect real retail workflows. Its approach prioritizes usability while retaining the operational detail businesses depend on. The product is intended for retail workflows and has operating experience in Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

Milestones reported for the product:
- PKR 1M+ in transaction value processed.
- 2 retail shops in operational use.
- 1+ year of operational experience across Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

These are operating milestones, not revenue figures or evidence of a large independent SaaS customer base.

### Oxford Grammar / Cambridge Edtech School
Type: Custom school management system.

The project began with a school's need to manage fee vouchers and attendance and expanded into an online system for organizing school operations and student information. Features include:
- Online student attendance.
- Teacher and staff attendance.
- Substitute teacher arrangements when a teacher is unavailable.
- Online student records.
- Student fee records and individual fee vouchers.
- Student performance records.

The school presented Afnan with a certificate in recognition of his work. Do not invent the certificate title or issuing organization's exact name; confirm them from the original certificate before publishing those details.

### Switch Power Co.
Website: https://switchpowersa.com/
Type: Business website.
Context: Electrical and lighting company in Saudi Arabia.
Purpose: Give the company an online presence and help visitors understand its products and services.

### Nexus Tech PK
Website: https://nexustech.pk/
Type: Online store and subscription tracking.
Context: Digital products and subscriptions.
Purpose: An online storefront supported by custom subscription tracking and renewal reminders.

## Vision

Afnan wants to help businesses and organizations make better use of technology. He is interested in reducing unnecessary manual work, organizing information, improving daily processes and supporting better decisions. Retail is one area of work, but his interests are not limited to one industry or one product.
